value.title: Grammaire Progressive du Français — Niveau intermédiaire — 3e édition

decisions.value: ChatGPT prepares/reviews Persian display labels and explanations under Content Owner authorization; current project Persian wording may be treated as approved initial canonical wording unless later revised through versioned review.

BILAN, Conjugaisons, Activités communicatives, Test d’évaluation, Index and analogous structural/reference/assessment sections are not lessons. They remain non-lesson source/reference/assessment entities.
Use Stage2 canonical taxonomy: 11 top-level categories + 27 subcategories + controlled tags. Stage1 grammar_family_draft is historical only.

downstream_resolution_policy.rule: Any downstream package whose only formal-readiness blockers are these three upstream codes may treat those blockers as RESOLVED by governance-v1.0.0. Stage-specific blockers remain in force.
downstream_resolution_policy.historical_artifacts: Existing v0.9 files are preserved as historical review snapshots and are not overwritten.

remaining_non_governance_dependencies.detail: Real questions cannot become APPROVED/PUBLISHED without a reviewer independent from the author/generator, per the Stage11 workflow. This does not block design stages.
Canonical PostgreSQL DDL should be executed against the real target environment before production deployment. SQLite/reference validation remains valid for design.
Static generator design can be formally accepted, but real production test generation still needs PUBLISHED serving inventory.
Empirical misconception frequency, observed difficulty and calibration require real usage data.
